# iaas_sandbox_volume (Resource)

A persistent data volume for sandboxes: a disk that keeps its data when a sandbox stops, pauses, resumes and (unless the attachment says delete_on_sandbox_delete) when the sandbox is deleted. It lives on ONE node of its location and the sandbox that uses it runs on that node. Attach it with the volumes argument of iaas_microvm. It is billed per GiB-hour of its size in the location until it is destroyed. Every argument forces a new volume (and loses the data): there is no resize in this release. Destroying a volume that a sandbox holds fails with volume_in_use; remove it from that sandbox (or destroy the sandbox) first. Import by id. Snapshots of a sandbox do not contain its volumes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A persistent data volume for sandboxes: a disk that keeps its data when a sandbox stops, pauses or is deleted.
# It lives on one node of the location, and the sandbox that mounts it runs on that node.
resource "iaas_sandbox_volume" "data" {
  name        = "agent-data"
  size_gib    = 20
  location_id = var.location_id
}

# Mount it when the sandbox is created. Changing the list later replaces the sandbox (a volume can only be attached
# or detached while the sandbox is stopped); the volume and its data stay.
resource "iaas_microvm" "worker" {
  name        = "worker"
  location_id = var.location_id
  image_id    = var.image_id
  plan_id     = var.plan_id
  network     = [{ kind = "public" }]

  volumes = [{
    volume_id  = iaas_sandbox_volume.data.id
    mount_path = "/data"
  }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `location_id` (String) The location (a location with sandbox nodes that offer volumes). Changing it forces a new volume.
- `name` (String) Display name. It also gives the default mount path (/mnt/<name>). Changing it forces a new volume.
- `size_gib` (Number) Size in GiB (1-1024). Changing it forces a new volume: the data is lost.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the volume was created (billing starts).
- `id` (String) Volume UUID.
- `mount_path` (String) Where the holding sandbox mounts it; null while free.
- `sandbox_id` (String) The sandbox that holds the volume; null while it is free.
- `status` (String) available, attached, attaching, detaching, pending, deleting or error.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by volume UUID. name, size_gib, location_id and the holding sandbox are read from the platform.
terraform import iaas_sandbox_volume.data 6a7b8c9d-0e1f-4a2b-8c3d-4e5f6a7b8c9d
```
